minecraft:lectern: A reading stand that holds a book and quill or a written book, so several players can read it. It is the job site of librarians. A comparator reads which page is open.
minecraft:target: A block that sends a redstone signal when hit by a projectile; the closer to the centre, the stronger. Craft it from a hay bale and four redstone dust. It is great for archery games and switches.
minecraft:lever: A switch that stays on or off when flipped. Craft it from a stick and cobblestone. It is the simplest way to power redstone.
minecraft:lightning_rod: A copper rod that attracts lightning strikes nearby, protecting flammable builds. It gives off a redstone signal when struck. Craft it from three copper ingots.
minecraft:daylight_detector: A sensor that outputs redstone power based on sunlight. Right-click it to invert it into a night detector. Craft it from glass, nether quartz and wooden slabs.
minecraft:sculk_sensor: A sculk block that detects vibrations like footsteps and doors within eight blocks and gives off a redstone signal. Wool blocks and sneaking keep you hidden from it. It is found in the deep dark.
minecraft:calibrated_sculk_sensor: A sculk sensor tuned with amethyst shards. A redstone signal on its side makes it listen only for one kind of vibration. It also hears a little further than a normal sensor.
minecraft:tripwire_hook: A hook that, with string stretched between two of them, makes a tripwire. Walking through the string sends a redstone signal. Craft it from an iron ingot, a stick and planks.
minecraft:trapped_chest: A chest that gives off a redstone signal when opened. The more players look inside, the stronger the signal. Craft it from a chest and a tripwire hook.
minecraft:tnt: An explosive block made from five gunpowder and four sand. Light it with flint and steel, fire or redstone, then stand back. It destroys most blocks around it.
minecraft:redstone_lamp: A lamp that lights up only while powered by redstone. Craft it from four redstone dust around glowstone. It gives full light when on.
minecraft:note_block: A block that plays a note when hit or powered. Right-click to change the pitch; the block underneath changes the instrument. Craft it from eight planks and redstone.
minecraft:stone_button: A stone button that sends a short redstone pulse when pressed. Craft it from one stone. Unlike wooden buttons, arrows can't press it.
minecraft:polished_blackstone_button: A blackstone button that sends a short redstone pulse when pressed. Craft it from one polished blackstone. Arrows can't press it.
minecraft:oak_button: A wooden button that sends a short redstone pulse when pressed. Craft it from one oak plank. Arrows can press wooden buttons too.

minecraft:stone_pressure_plate: A stone plate that powers redstone when a mob or player stands on it. Craft it from two stone. Dropped items don't trigger it.
minecraft:polished_blackstone_pressure_p: A blackstone plate that powers redstone when a mob or player stands on it. Craft it from two polished blackstone. Dropped items don't trigger it.
minecraft:light_weighted_pressure_plate: A gold pressure plate that gives a stronger signal the more things stand on it. Craft it from two gold ingots. It counts items as well as mobs.
minecraft:heavy_weighted_pressure_plate: An iron pressure plate that measures weight, needing many more things for a strong signal. Craft it from two iron ingots. It counts items as well as mobs.
minecraft:oak_pressure_plate: A wooden plate that powers redstone when something presses it. Craft it from two oak planks. Unlike stone plates, it also reacts to dropped items and arrows.

minecraft:powered_rail: A rail that speeds minecarts up when powered and brakes them when not. Craft gold ingots, a stick and redstone into six. Place one every so often to keep carts moving.
minecraft:detector_rail: A rail that gives off a redstone signal while a minecart is on it. Craft it from iron ingots, a stone pressure plate and redstone. Use it to trigger stations and switches.
minecraft:rail: The basic track for minecarts. Craft six iron ingots and a stick into sixteen. Rails curve automatically to connect to each other.
minecraft:activator_rail: A rail that triggers special minecarts when powered. It ignites TNT minecarts, toggles hopper minecarts and throws riders off. Craft it from iron, sticks and a redstone torch.
minecraft:saddle: Gear for riding horses, donkeys, mules, pigs and striders. It can't be crafted; find it in chests, while fishing or from leatherworkers. Pigs and striders also need a lure on a stick to steer.
minecraft:minecart: A cart that rides along rails. Craft it from five iron ingots. Players and mobs can ride in it, and it can be combined with a chest, furnace, hopper or TNT.
minecraft:chest_minecart: A minecart carrying a chest with 27 slots. Craft it from a minecart and a chest. Hoppers can load and unload it, making it perfect for item transport.
minecraft:furnace_minecart: A minecart with a furnace that pushes itself and other carts. Give it coal or charcoal to start it moving. It is the only self-powered minecart.
minecraft:tnt_minecart: A minecart loaded with TNT. It explodes when it passes over a powered activator rail or crashes from a height. Craft it from a minecart and TNT.
minecraft:hopper_minecart: A minecart with a hopper that collects items along the track and from containers above. Craft it from a minecart and a hopper. Pair it with a hopper below the rails to unload it.
minecraft:carrot_on_a_stick: A fishing rod with a carrot tied to it. Hold it while riding a saddled pig to steer it. Each boost wears it down a little.
minecraft:warped_fungus_on_a_stick: A fishing rod with a warped fungus tied to it. Hold it while riding a saddled strider to steer it across lava. Each boost wears it down a little.
minecraft:elytra: Wings found on End ships, worn in the chestplate slot. Jump while falling to glide, and use firework rockets to fly. Repair it with phantom membranes.
minecraft:oak_boat: A oak boat for crossing water quickly. Craft it from five oak planks. It carries two passengers, and mobs pushed into it get stuck.
minecraft:oak_chest_boat: A oak boat with a chest on board. Craft it from a oak boat and a chest. It carries one passenger plus 27 slots of cargo.

minecraft:spruce_chest_boat: A spruce boat with a chest on board. Craft it from a spruce boat and a chest. It carries one passenger plus 27 slots of cargo.
